name: Ballistic Sidearm
special: Clip holds 10 uses of Ammo. Ammo box contains 100 bullets and costs 100 credits.

name: Standard Sidearm
special: Easily concealed weapon. Common and mass-produced.

name: Spouter
special: Only deals damage to electronic based targets. Requires water to refill. Holds 10 shots. If weapon hits, target is considered “wet.”

name: Plexi L82
special: Very small, easily concealed weapon.

name: Syklopse 17
special: Equipped with mid-range scope.

name: L-X Custom Royal
special: Each time weapon is Charged, choose one of the following bonuses: “+1D8+2 Damage” “+2 To-Hit” “+2 Range” “+1 Fire intensity” “Ignores Damage Reduction” or “+3D12 Damage & 2 CvC round cooldown” Options may be chosen more than once, except for the last option

name: Quiet
special: Fires silent. Easily concealed weapon.

name: CF-Leprechaun
special: If Charged, any element can be chosen when fired.

name: Multi-Lock Bizi 21
special: Option to fire at two targets at once. If you do, To-Hit modifier is +2 instead of +4. Damage dice are then divided evenly for each target.

name: SnP 400
special: Add +1D6 damage for every three points To-Hit is over Targets Defense Score; up to 3D6.

name: Disabler
damage: None Element: Light & Sound Range: 4 Max Size Class: C Target must roll Willpower + Resist Distress difficulty 15. For every 2 points this roll is failed by, it reduces the targets combat actions by one on their next round. 1 Exertion may be spent by target to reclaim a lost action. Aim Dice are not added to damage when Aim action is performed. 950
special: Target must roll Willpower + Resist Distress difficulty 15. For every 2 points this roll is failed by, it reduces the targets combat actions by one on their next round. 1 Exertion may be spent by target to reclaim a lost action. Aim Dice are not added to damage when Aim action is performed. 950 Charge Bonus: None Max Charge: N/A

name: Phazor
special: Mirrors and shiny surfaces will reflect full damage but reduces To-Hit bonus to 0, and instead of Projectile add Science/Physics for To-Hit roll.

name: Greentip V-X 101
special: After To-Hit roll is calculated, subtract 4 and add 1D10. Ignores damage reduction. At the end of each round Target takes 1D8 poison damage for each 4 rolled on Damage Dice. This Damage persists for 1 hour. Does not deal damage to electronic based targets. Aim Dice are not added to damage when Aim action is performed.

name: Homing Spike Pistol
special: During charge period target must remain in crosshairs. Opponents Defense Score is halved against this weapon. This weapon does not double critical-hit damage. Ammo clips cost 30 credits. Clip is good for 5 uses.

name: Scatterforce
special: Add +1 damage for every point To-Hit roll is over Targets Defense Score.

name: Ionic Shotgun
special: Ignore the standard range modifier rules with this weapon; every 2 units target is away adds +1 To-Hit roll and reduces damage by 1D10 (Targets Dodge Score is not modified by range)

name: Rusty Sawed-Off
special: Ignore the standard range modifier rules with this weapon; each unit away from target adds +2 To-Hit roll and reduces damage by 2D6 (Targets Dodge Score is not modified by range.) Must be reloaded after each shot. Ammo box contains 50 bullets and costs 100 credits.

name: T16 Autoblaster 5000
special: Add +1D8 damage for every three points To-Hit is over Targets Defense Score; up to 3D8. Common and mass-produced.

name: Viltrexian Devastator
special: If attack gets a critical hit, roll 4D20 for damage instead of 4D12. (Damage is still doubled)

name: Prism Aperture 8400
special: Scope adapts visual spectrum to dynamically identify possible targets (heat vision, low light vision, high light vision, x-ray vision, ultraviolet, and over ten others.) This negates any visual and cover modifiers in targets favor, but masks their identity while looking through scope.

name: Thunder Rifle
special: After To-Hit roll is calculated, subtract 5 and add 1D10. Each time weapon is charged, increase the die type used to determine the number of D12 damage dice. Deals double damage to wet, frozen, or electronic based targets.

name: Dark Matter Launcher
special: At the end of the round, target loses 2D8 HP for every 10 damage inflicted. This extra damage ignores damage reduction and is delt directly to character even if wearing armor.

name: CC 9000
special: Target must roll Strength + Break Free difficulty 13. If roll is failed, Target is considered “frozen.” For every 2 points this roll is failed by, it reduces the targets combat actions by one on their next round. 1 Exertion may be spent by target to reclaim a lost action.

name: Fireball Launcher
special: Target catches fire at intensity level 2 (See When a Character is on Fire)

name: Frost Thrower
special: For every *16 damage this weapon deals, reduce the Targets combat actions by 1 and they are considered “frozen”. 1 Exertion may be spent by target to reclaim a lost action.

name: Power Clamp
special: Robotic clamp for use to manipulate large objects. Adds +9 to Lift/Push/Pull when used.

name: Power Drill
special: Portable drill that can penetrate most natural formations. Ignores damage reduction.

name: Gravity Gun
special: Picks up nearby objects with synthetic gravity well and projects to cause damage. Objects are ranked between 1 and 8 by GM based on weight and jaggedness. Object rating determines factor X. Can lift a maximum weight of 20 lbs. Examples: Hardcover Book = 1 Fire Extinguisher = 4 Metallic Buzzsaw = 8

name: Solar Powered T44 Cannon
special: 8500 Examples: Pitch Black = 0 Indoor Lighting = 2 Desert at noon = 8 X factor is based on solar brightness of area rated between 1 and 8.

name: Bore Launcher
special: Launches auto-guided robotic drone to burrow into objects or people. Holds up to 5 Bores. (Critical hits do not deal double damage) Ammo Cards: Hull Bore, Skull Bore

name: Mine Launcher
special: Specialized explosive launcher with high-tech ammunition. Weapon has 1-Turn Cooldown between shots. Holds up to 10 Mines. (Critical hits do not deal double damage) Ammo Cards: Proximity Mine, Sticky Grenade, Rubber Bouncy Balls, Mini Nuke

name: Proximity Mine
special: Places a motion-detection mine up to 8 units away. Mine will not detonate while within 15 units of Launcher. When motion is detected within 3 units, mine detonates. Reduce Damage Multiplier by x1 for every unit away from mine. This item may be used without launcher by placing manually. If set this way mine will not detonate within the first 5 combat rounds. 300 Mine Launcher Ammo

name: Sticky Grenade
special: Timed bomb that can stick to any surface. Bomb detonates at the beginning of your next combat round. If bomb hits a character, they may take an action to roll Strength + Break Free Difficulty 13 to remove bomb. A separate action is required to throw. Deals damage to all within 5 units. Reduce Damage Multiplier by x1 for every unit away from Mine. May be used without a launcher. If used this way See Throwing Objects rule. 300 Mine Launcher Ammo

name: Force Bazooka
special: Also hits characters/objects behind target for half damage.

name: Silent Scope Sniper Rifle
special: ALL damage dice that roll a 6 or higher are treated as 15s. (This includes bonus dice from Aim action) Charging this weapon requires an accompaning Aim action. Charges are lost if Aim bonuses are lost. Uses Magnesium or Iron mineral as ammo. Holds 8 rounds.

name: Inverted Pulse Sniper Rifle
special: This deadly silenced weapon uses an inverted pulse, meaning that the entry and exit wounds are reversed. Fires silent, and creates no flash from muzzle. Charging this weapon requires an accompanying Aim action. Charges are lost if Aim bonuses are lost.

name: MK-U ID Assassin
special: Gun equipped with safety function that makes weapon impossible to fire unless it is being aimed at a pre-designated target. Target ID input can be added to scopes software via DNA sample or photograph. Targeting system has password protected security to prevent adjustments. Target ID can also be changed to more generalized purpose, such as only firing on a specific race or sex.

name: Amplify Gauntlets
special: Target is knocked back a number of units equal to the number of dice you have in Strength. Add Charge Bonus for each Unit you traveled this round before attack. Cannot be used with duel-wielding.

name: Electricity Blade
special: If you score a Critical Hit, target loses thier next two combat actions. 1 Exertion may be spent by target to reclaim a lost action. Deals double damage to wet, frozen, or electronic based targets. Add Charge Bonus for each Unit you traveled this round before attack.

name: Fusion Blade
special: Add +2D8 damage for each die Fusion occurrence in To-Hit roll. Add Charge Bonus for each Unit you traveled this round before attack.

name: Murasama Blade
special: Ionically charged High-Frequency vibration diamond edged sword with kinetic ejection sheath. You may unsheathe the sword and attack as the same action- if you do, add +1D10 to both the Damage and Charge Bonus for that attack. Takes 2 combat actions to put into sheath. Add Charge Bonus for each Unit you traveled this round before attack. Cannot be used with duel-wielding.

name: Hyper Thermalized Katana
special: Ignores ALL damage reduction. Target catches fire at intensity level 2 (See When a Character is on Fire) Add Charge Bonus for each Unit you traveled this round before attack.

name: Netlauncher
special: If hit, Target must spend an action and roll Dexterity + Break Free difficulty 10 to escape. While inside Net, Move and Melee actions are unavailable. GM will Increase difficulty to escape if target is smaller than an average adult human, and reduce difficulty of larger. Requires reload after each shot. Nets cost 20 credits each. Aim Dice are not added to damage when Aim action is performed.

Decrease this difficulty by 1 for each unit away from ground zero. GM may modify this further depending on cover. If roll is failed, characters lose 1 action on their next turn for every 2 points difficulty was failed by. Detonates at the beginning of your turn after next. 60

GM may modify this further depending on cover. If roll is failed, characters lose 1 action on their next turn for every 2 points difficulty was failed by. name: Grenade
special: See Throwing Objects. Reduce damage multiplier by 1 for each unit away from ground zero. GM may modify this further depending on cover.
